description: Systems mirror the communication structure of the organization that builds them. Team boundaries and code boundaries tend to converge.
Shaping teams around the architecture you want, so the organization reinforces the boundaries instead of eroding them.
One build and one deploy split into domain modules with public APIs, enforced boundaries and clear ownership.
One repository holding several apps and internal packages, with tooling (Nx, Turborepo) that builds and tests only what changed.
Independently built and deployed frontend applications composed into one product at build time, on the server, at the edge or in the browser.
Separately deployed parts that still must ship together or share internals: the costs of distribution without its independence.
